reviews.comment: Dr. Saravanan is boring unfortunately. His lecturing is not well prepared and confusing. I lost interest in climate sciences after attending his class. His graduate student shared that he is also very bad at mentoring graduate students and basically don't care about student growth nor guidance. Be aware of joining his class or his lab.

I actually liked this class. Professor Saravanan made it easy to work with python. I actually like to code now. His lecture notes really help cover the material needed for the homework. The quizzes made you think. The group project really helped and made the coding course well rounded although the final exam was difficult.

Dr. Saravanan cares about the material and will adjust and re-explain when people don't understand. He expects participation in class, but can often be brusque about wrong answers. Attend class for participation points and read the book and you will be fine, although this class requires effort to get a really good grade; it's not an easy A.

I enjoyed this class, because I find the subject matter interesting. However, lecture can be a bit dry. Dr. Saravanan is clearly knowledgeable and passionate and wants his students to succeed. He is accessible outside of class and is more than willing to re-explain concepts.

He was a pretty decent professor. Homework was fairly easy. Also he posted notes online. His test arent too difficult. Being 50 minutes is what makes it a little challening for 50 ish questions. Overall i would take him again. he taught according to the textbook. Also he had partipation questions at the beginning of class

ATMO321 is essentially a python coding class, which I was not aware of before registering for it. However, Dr. R is a good professor and cares about the success of the students. There are multiple participation points and homework assignments as well as quizzes, but only one project and one (difficult) final exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy, but he makes the course harder than it needs to be. He had to curve all of our tests. I always put in the effort and I never missed class. I thought it would be an easy A, but not so much. It is possible to get an A with the curves and if you are able to do well on the homework.
